name: Leica Q2
description: Leica Q2 数码相机。技术参数依据厂家规格表或官方说明书整理，具体模式及测试条件可通过逐项来源查阅。

rows.label: 传感器画幅
rows.value: 24 x 36 mm

rows.label: 数码裁切
rows.value: 28 mm, 35 mm, 50 mm, 75 mm

rows.label: 传感器类型与像素
rows.value: 全画幅 CMOS 传感器, 50.4/47.3 百万像素 (总像素/有效像素)

rows.label: 色彩深度
rows.value: 14 bit

rows.label: DNG / JPEG 分辨率
rows.value: JPEG: Zoom 28 mm: 47 mega像素 (8368x5584 像素), 24 mega像素 (6000x4000 像素), 12 mega像素 (4271x2848 像素) Zoom 35 mm: 30 mega像素 (6704x4472 像素), 15 mega像素 (4800x3200 像素), 8 mega像素 (3424x2288 像素) Zoom 50 mm: 15 mega像素 (4688x3128 像素), 8 mega像素 (3360x2240 像素), 4 mega像素 (2400x1600 像素) Zoom 75 mm: 7 mega像素 (3136x2096 像素), 3 mega像素 (2240x1496 像素), 2 mega像素 (1600x1072 像素) DNG: Zoom 28 mm: 46,7 mega像素 (8368x5584 像素)

rows.label: 色彩空间
rows.value: sRGB / Adobe RGB / ECI RGB V.2.0

rows.label: JPEG 风格
rows.value: Standard, Vivid, Natural, Monochrome, Monochrome High Contrast, all with additional settings for contrast, saturation, and sharpness in 5 steps

rows.label: 镜头系统
rows.value: Leica Summilux 28 f/1.7 ASPH., 11 elements in 9 groups, 3 aspherical elements

rows.label: 防抖
rows.value: Optical compensation system for photo and video recordings

rows.label: 光圈范围
rows.value: 1.7 to 16 in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 对焦距离
rows.value: 30 cm to ∞, with macro setting from 17 cm

rows.label: 对焦方式
rows.value: Automatic (autofocus) or manual focusing, option of magnifying function and edge marking (focus peaking) available for manual setting

rows.label: 自动对焦系统
rows.value: Contrast-based autofocus system

rows.label: 自动对焦模式
rows.value: AFS (shutter release only after successful focusing), AFC (shutter release possible at any time), AF setting can be saved

rows.label: 自动对焦测量方式
rows.value: Single zone (225 fields), multi-field, face recognition, subject tracking

rows.label: OLED 取景器
rows.value: Resolution: 1280 × 960 像素 x 3 colors (=3.68 MP), image field: 约 100%, aspect ratio: 4:3, eye distance: 21mm adjustable -4 - +3 diopters, with eye sensor for automatic switching between viewfinder and monitor

rows.label: 显示屏
rows.value: 3" TFT LCD monitor with 约 1,040,000 像素, touch control possible

rows.label: ISO 范围
rows.value: Automatic, ISO 50, ISO 100, ISO 200, ISO 400, ISO 800, ISO 1600, ISO 3200, ISO 6400, ISO 12500, ISO 25000, ISO 50000

rows.label: 白平衡
rows.value: Automatic, default settings for: daylight, cloudy, halogen lighting, shadow, electronic flash, gray card, manual color temperature setting

rows.label: 曝光模式
rows.value: Automatic program, aperture priority, shutter speed priority and manual setting

rows.label: 测光
rows.value: Multi-field, center-weighted, spot

rows.label: 曝光补偿
rows.value: ±3 EV in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 自动包围曝光
rows.value: 3 or 5 exposures in graduations of 最高 3 EV, can be set in 1⁄3 EV increments
rows.originalValue: 3 or 5 exposures in graduations of up to 3 EV, can be set in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 快门类型
rows.value: Optionally mechanical, electronical or hybrid

rows.label: 快门速度
rows.value: 60 s to 1⁄2000 s with mech. Shutter, 1 s to 1⁄40000 s with electr. shutter, in 1⁄3 increments, flash synchronization 最高 1⁄500 s, Linear flashes with all shutter speeds less than 1⁄ 500 s possible (with HSS-enabled SCA 3002 standard flash units)
rows.originalValue: 60 s to 1⁄2000 s with mech. Shutter, 1 s to 1⁄40000 s with electr. shutter, in 1⁄3 increments, flash synchronization up to 1⁄500 s, Linear flashes with all shutter speeds less than 1⁄ 500 s possible (with HSS-enabled SCA 3002 standard flash units)

rows.value: Digital 35 mm compact camera, fixed focal length

rows.label: 动态范围
rows.value: 14 aperture stops at ISO 100

rows.label: 照片格式

rows.value: MP4 (C4K / 4K / FullHD)

rows.value: 立体声

rows.value: 单声道
